title: 第1177章 禀报宗主第1183章 刘仪担忧
slug: 开局一枚玉佩凡女低调修仙
lines: 而且江晚萤的运气确实奇佳，大挪移符直接将她传送到了妖兽森林外围相对安全的区域。
此刻，江晚萤正在布置一个陷阱。
她并没有采用传统的剑修斗法方式去寻找妖兽。
而是用长剑在地上挖出了一个深达丈许的大坑。
接着，用树枝与落叶将洞口巧妙地掩盖起来。
布置完毕后，江晚萤走到一旁的草丛中，割下几株散发着浓郁腥味的诱妖草，扔在陷阱正中央。
随后，她轻手轻脚地爬上旁边一棵古树的粗壮枝干，屏住呼吸，静静等待。
不多时，一阵悉悉索索的声音从林间传来。
三只体型硕大、相当于练气八层的獠牙野猪被诱妖草的气味吸引，哼哧哼哧地跑了过来。
野猪们毫无防备地冲向诱妖草。
“咔嚓”一声脆响，伪装的树枝断裂。
三只獠牙野猪齐刷刷地掉进了深坑之中。
坑底的空间十分狭窄，三头体型庞大的野猪挤在一起，根本无法借力跳出。
江晚萤见状，大喜过望。
从树枝上一跃而下，走到陷阱边缘。
她并没有使用凌厉的剑气进行斩杀，而是将长剑收回剑鞘。随后，从储物袋中摸出一根粗壮的玄铁木棍。
江晚萤双手握着木棍，对准坑底那些还在挣扎的野猪脑袋，狠狠地敲了下去。
伴随着几声沉闷的击打声，三只獠牙野猪被敲晕在坑底。
江晚萤拍了拍手上的灰尘，开心地跳下深坑，熟练地用匕首挑出妖兽材料收入储物袋。
这种既节省灵力又能高效获取材料的务实方法，让她十分满意。
一道青色剑光从天而降，稳稳地落在空地边缘。
苏月站在一旁，全程目睹了徒弟这番接地气且略带滑稽的狩猎过程。
她的嘴角忍不住微微上扬，眼中满是无奈与好笑。
“剑修的锋芒，便是被你用来挖坑敲闷棍的吗？”
一道清冷熟悉的声音传来。
江晚萤猛地抬起头，看到站在坑边的苏月，脸上瞬间绽放出灿烂的笑容。
“师尊！”
江晚萤手脚并用地爬出深坑，开心地跑到苏月面前，仰着头看着完好无缺的师尊。
那些担忧与后怕在这一刻全部烟消云散。
“这妖兽皮糙肉厚，用剑气太费灵力了。敲晕了再取材料，省时省力嘛。”江晚萤理直气壮地解释着自己的务实战术。
苏月伸手拍了拍江晚萤沾满泥土的肩膀。
两人迎着穿透林间的微风，并肩向着森林外走去，准备踏上返回宗门的归途，去揭开那隐藏在黑暗深处的最后阴谋。
夜色深沉。
苏月带着江晚萤，驾驭飞剑，平稳地降落在灵虚派揽月峰的青石广场上。
江晚萤伤势未愈，脚步虚浮。
苏月伸出右手，渡入一道温和的青色灵力，护住徒弟的心脉。
两人步入洞府。苏月从储物袋中取出两枚疗伤丹药，递给徒弟，看着对方服下并盘膝打坐。
确认江晚萤气息平稳后，苏月转身走出洞府，开启了揽月峰的防御阵法。
矿区阵法破碎，大量外门与杂役弟子重获生机。
干瘪的躯体重新焕发活力，跌落的境界也开始回升。
content_en:
Moreover, Jiang Wanying's luck was really good. The Great Teleportation Talisman directly teleported her to a relatively safe area outside the Monster Forest.
At this moment, Jiang Wanying was setting up a trap.
She did not use traditional sword fighting methods to find monsters.
Instead, he used his long sword to dig a large hole in the ground that was about ten feet deep.
Then, the hole was cleverly covered with branches and fallen leaves.
After finishing the arrangement, Jiang Wanying walked to the grass nearby, cut off a few demon-luring grasses that exuded a strong fishy smell, and threw them in the center of the trap.
Then, she gently climbed up the thick branch of an ancient tree nearby, held her breath, and waited quietly.
Not long after, a rustling sound came from the forest.
Three huge tusked wild boars, equivalent to the eighth level of Qi training, were attracted by the scent of the demon-luring grass and ran over with a groan.
The wild boars rushed toward the demon-luring grass without any defense.
There was a crisp "click" sound, and the disguised branch broke.
Three tusked wild boars fell into the pit.
The space at the bottom of the pit is very narrow, and three huge wild boars are crowded together, unable to use their strength to jump out.
Jiang Wanying was overjoyed when she saw this.
Jump down from the branch and walk to the edge of the trap.
She did not use the sharp sword energy to kill, but put the long sword back into the scabbard. Then, he took out a thick black iron wooden stick from the storage bag.
Jiang Wanying held the wooden stick in both hands, aimed it at the heads of the struggling wild boars at the bottom of the pit, and struck it hard.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
With a few dull blows, three tusked wild boars were knocked unconscious at the bottom of the pit.
Jiang Wanying patted the dust on her hands, happily jumped down into the pit, and skillfully used her dagger to pick out the monster materials and put them into her storage bag.
This pragmatic method that not only saves spiritual energy but also obtains materials efficiently makes her very satisfied.
A green sword light fell from the sky and landed steadily on the edge of the clearing.
Su Yue stood aside and witnessed the apprentice's down-to-earth and slightly funny hunting process.
The corners of her mouth couldn't help but raise slightly, and her eyes were full of helplessness and amusement.
"Is the sharp edge of the sword cultivator used by you to dig holes and knock out sap?"
A cold and familiar voice came.
Jiang Wanying suddenly raised her head and saw Su Yue standing by the pit, a bright smile instantly bloomed on her face.
"Master!"
Jiang Wanying crawled out of the pit on her hands and knees and happily ran to Su Yue, looking up at her intact master.
All those worries and fears disappeared at this moment.
"This monster has rough skin and thick flesh. It takes too much spiritual energy to use sword energy. Knock it out and then get the materials to save time and effort." Jiang Wanying explained her pragmatic tactics confidently.
Su Yue reached out and patted Jiang Wanying's muddy shoulder.
The two of them faced the breeze that penetrated the forest and walked side by side out of the forest, preparing to return to the sect and uncover the final conspiracy hidden deep in the darkness.
The night is dark.
Su Yue took Jiang Wanying, controlled the flying sword, and landed smoothly on the bluestone square of Lingxu Sect's Yue Peak.
Jiang Wanying's injury has not healed and her steps are sluggish.
Su Yue stretched out her right hand and channeled a gentle blue spiritual power to protect her apprentice's heart.
The two of them entered the cave. Su Yue took out two healing elixirs from her storage bag, handed them to her apprentice, and watched as he took them and meditated cross-legged.
After confirming that Jiang Wanying's breath was stable, Su Yue turned around and walked out of the cave, activating the defensive formation of Lan Yue Peak.
The formation in the mining area was broken, and a large number of outer sect and handyman disciples regained their vitality.
The withered body regained its vitality, and the realm from which it fell began to rise again.
